turn.say: NakhlaID says NID-423 when I try to sign in. What should I do?

turns.reply: Your NakhlaID account is locked because of 5 failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes, which causes the NID-423 error. The lockout lasts 30 minutes. To regain access, wait 30 minutes and then try signing in again. If you forgot your password, reset it yourself at https://id.nakhla.example/reset by entering your work email and following the prompts with your NakhlaKey or backup codes. After resetting, sign out and back in on all devices to avoid further lockouts.

turn.say: NakhlaConnect shows NX-781 when I connect from home. I have version 5.1 and the VPN guide says 4.8 or later is supported, so what is wrong?

turns.reply: The error code NX-781 means your NakhlaConnect client version is below the minimum supported version. Since 2026-06-01, the minimum supported client version is 5.4, and your version 5.1 is not accepted. You need to update to version 5.4.2 from the Software Center and then restart NakhlaConnect. Do not try to bypass this version check by editing the client configuration, as this is forbidden by security policy.
